The '''Grand Theater of Vreni Island''' was an outdoor theater on [[Vreni Island]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. It was the pride of the citizens of Vreni Island.<ref name="SWG:GToVI" />

==Behind the scenes==
Players in ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'' can receive an "exploration badge" for visiting this location in the game.<ref name="SWG:LOtiVI">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=other}}Exploration Badge: "Location: Outdoor theater in Vreni Island" on Corellia</ref>
